claims.subject: Candidate Processor
claims.evidence_quote: When a candidate processor learns about an update to the value of w1, it broadcasts this information to all other candidate processors.

claims.subject: Committee Processor
claims.evidence_quote: Before updating τ, the committee processors may receive O(n) tokens that require O(n(ln n∕α)2) messages taken by the committee processors.

claims.subject: Phase 1
claims.evidence_quote: As a consequence, O(n(ln n∕α)2) ⋅ O(lg w) messages are taken by the phase 1.

claims.subject: Phase 2
claims.evidence_quote: In the case of phase 2, whenever a processor receives the trigger, the processor sends the message to the committee processors and the committee processors further send the message to all the committee processors (if not sent earlier), which requires O(n(ln n∕α)2) messages.
